name: @usdk/host-local
description: Connected-mode local runtime host: an explicitly started Node.js process exposing a paired, session-authenticated HTTP API that a browser client (@usdk/binding-javascript) talks to. Reuses @usdk/host-browser's ConversationSession unmodified for the conversation/consensus logic (it is plain JS with no browser-only API dependency) and adds the transport, pairing/auth, and a bridge to the native usdk.exe CLI's dynamic C-ABI module loading for /native/* diagnostics - see README.md.
